distinct_from_r5: C7 is a constant strategic allocation with semiannual drift bands, not absolute momentum.
C7 has no positive-sleeve gating, relative ranking, defensive fallback or parameter-survivor logic.
C7 adds a fixed CSI 500 sleeve and retains all sleeves structurally; it does not select them from R5 results.

cost_load.meaning: A fixed arithmetic load only; it is not an observed broker fee, tax, spread, impact, settlement or fill model.

fixed_diagnostic_rule.review_frequency: After the final common close in March and September; any action becomes effective on the following common session.
fixed_diagnostic_rule.signal_or_selection: none; all six sleeves exist structurally from the initial common session
fixed_diagnostic_rule.trade_trigger: Rebalance only when at least one sleeve exceeds its fixed absolute target-weight band.

interpretation.allowed_use: Identify whether this fixed candidate deserves a separately frozen, entitled total-return-and-execution test; it cannot authorize a holding, a trade, a target-return claim or a final strategy.
why: The endpoint's price adjustment basis is not stated, and it has no synchronized distribution or fund-event ledger; the arithmetic cannot be called investor total return.
Historical rows are retrospectively retrieved, not point-in-time available-at evidence.
No market-status, bid/ask, depth, broker fee, tax, settlement, account-permission, partial-fill or no-fill record exists, so the arithmetic cannot establish personal operability.
The protocol is exploratory after related ETF public observations existed, so a positive arithmetic result would not be independent strategy evidence.

source.price_basis: SSE endpoint does not disclose an adjustment basis; market price is not independently established as investor total return.
